tools.name: ytdlp_check_environment
tools.description: Check whether this MCP server can run yt-dlp workflows on the host. Use before the first download or when PATH, ffmpeg, ffprobe, cookies, plugins, or policy settings may be misconfigured.

tools.name: ytdlp_list_extractors
tools.description: List all site extractors supported by the installed yt-dlp binary. Use when the user asks whether a website or URL family is supported.

tools.name: ytdlp_list_impersonation_targets
tools.description: List browser impersonation targets supported by the installed yt-dlp binary. Use when a download needs browser-like request headers or extractor troubleshooting.

tools.name: ytdlp_search_videos
tools.description: Search YouTube through yt-dlp without downloading media and return compact video results. Use when the user asks to find videos before choosing one to inspect or download.

tools.name: ytdlp_get_metadata
tools.description: Extract structured metadata for a media URL without downloading files using yt-dlp --dump-json. Use to inspect title, duration, uploader, formats, subtitles, thumbnails, and selected best format.

tools.name: ytdlp_list_formats
tools.description: List available audio/video formats for a media URL without downloading files. Use when the user asks what quality, codec, resolution, bitrate, or format IDs are available.

tools.name: ytdlp_list_subtitles
tools.description: List available manual subtitles and automatic captions for a media URL without downloading files. Use when the user asks which subtitle languages or formats exist.

tools.name: ytdlp_list_thumbnails
tools.description: List available thumbnails for a media URL without downloading files. Use when the user asks for cover images, thumbnail URLs, resolutions, or poster options.

tools.name: ytdlp_probe_url
tools.description: Probe whether yt-dlp supports a media URL and identify the extractor without downloading files. Use for quick support checks before planning or downloading.

tools.name: ytdlp_plan_download
tools.description: Dry-run a video, audio, subtitle, thumbnail, or playlist download without writing files. Use to answer what would happen, which format best quality resolves to, required dependencies, output paths, risks, and exact yt-dlp argv.

tools.name: ytdlp_plan_postprocess
tools.description: Dry-run post-processing without writing files. Use to explain ffmpeg requirements, output policy, risks, and side effects for remux, recode, audio extraction, embedded assets, chapters, or SponsorBlock.

tools.name: ytdlp_validate_options
tools.description: Validate typed yt-dlp option input and expose the source-derived option catalog. Use to answer whether a flag or option is supported without executing yt-dlp.

tools.name: ytdlp_download_video
tools.description:
Download a web video URL to the managed output root, including YouTube and youtu.be links.

Use when: The user asks to download, save, fetch, or get a local video file from a media URL; asks for best quality/highest quality; asks for a specific format/resolution; asks to trim sections; or asks for overwrite behavior.
Don't use when: The user only wants audio, subtitles, thumbnails, metadata, or a dry-run plan.

Note: This is the intended MCP path for permitted user-provided media download requests such as "download <YouTube URL> in best quality". Default video format selection plans as bestvideo*+bestaudio/best unless the user asks otherwise. This creates local files under the configured output root.

tools.name: ytdlp_download_audio
tools.description:
Download or extract audio from a web media URL to the managed output root.

Use when: The user asks for audio-only output, MP3, M4A, Opus, WAV, best audio, podcast/music extraction, or keeping audio without video.
Don't use when: The user needs a video file with visuals, subtitles only, thumbnails only, metadata, or a dry-run plan.

Note: This creates local audio files under the configured output root.

tools.name: ytdlp_download_subtitles
tools.description: Download subtitles or captions for a media URL without downloading the video. Use when the user asks for subtitle languages, auto captions, subtitle formats, subtitle files, transcripts with timestamps, or subtitle conversion.

tools.name: ytdlp_download_thumbnail
tools.description: Download thumbnail image files for a media URL without downloading the video. Use when the user asks for a cover image, thumbnail, poster frame, or all thumbnails.

tools.name: ytdlp_download_playlist
tools.description: Download playlist, channel, or multi-video URL entries to the managed output root. Use when the user asks to download a playlist/channel, select playlist ranges, skip existing archive entries, cap max downloads, randomize order, or stop on existing files.

tools.name: ytdlp_inspect_archive
tools.description: Read a yt-dlp download archive file under the configured filesystem policy and return its saved archive entries. Use when the user asks what is already in an archive.

tools.name: ytdlp_check_archive
tools.description: Check whether an exact yt-dlp archive entry string exists in an archive file under the configured filesystem policy. This does not resolve a video URL into its archive ID.

tools.name: ytdlp_update_archive
tools.description: Return a safe archive-update plan and recommendation without writing the archive. Prefer using downloadArchive on download tools so yt-dlp writes canonical extractor IDs.

tools.name: ytdlp_remux
tools.description: Download a media URL and remux the resulting video container with ffmpeg, defaulting to MP4 without re-encoding. Use when the user asks to convert containers such as MKV/WebM to MP4.

tools.name: ytdlp_recode
tools.description: Download a media URL and re-encode the resulting video with ffmpeg, defaulting to MP4. Use when the user asks for a target video format and accepts re-encoding.

tools.name: ytdlp_extract_audio
tools.description: Download a media URL and extract an audio file with ffmpeg/ffprobe. Use when the user asks for MP3, M4A, Opus, WAV, best audio, or audio-only output.

tools.name: ytdlp_embed_assets
tools.description: Download a media URL and embed subtitles, thumbnail, metadata, chapters, or infojson into the output file. Use when the user asks for a self-contained media file with embedded assets.

tools.name: ytdlp_split_chapters
tools.description: Download a media URL and split the result into one file per chapter. Use when the user asks to create separate chapter files or segment a chaptered video.

tools.name: ytdlp_remove_chapters
tools.description: Download a media URL and remove chapters matching configured regex filters, defaulting to sponsor-like chapters. Use for chapter removal workflows that need ffmpeg cuts.

tools.name: ytdlp_apply_sponsorblock
tools.description: Download a media URL and apply SponsorBlock mark or remove options. Use when the user asks to mark, remove, or chapter SponsorBlock categories during download.

tools.name: ytdlp_execute_expert
tools.description: Execute reviewed raw yt-dlp argv only when typed tools cannot express the request. Disabled unless YTDLP_MCP_ENABLE_EXPERT=true; dry-run is default and unsafe/path-gated flags are blocked by policy.
